setup_command: docker network create babi-postgres-sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --rm --name babi-postgres-sandbox --network babi-postgres-sandbox -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec babi-postgres-sandbox pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'postgres never became ready' >&2; exit 1
teardown_command: docker rm -f babi-postgres-sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network rm babi-postgres-sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0
